geometry.storage_volume_scope: The pressure reservoir includes only volumes upstream of its closed valve, with their actual temperatures. Tabulated thicknesses are void-equivalent volumes per wall area, not automatically the geometric plenum depth.

gas_thermodynamic_scales.scope: Ideal dilute-gas sensible and reversible cooling estimates; adsorption heat, solid hardware cycling, heat leaks and actual refrigerator efficiency are separate.

conditional_notes: 10m³/s/m²Hgetter at300K is a selected value within a primary CERN range;13m³/s/m²He is a primary low-load cryopanel graph scale, not certified present geometry.

S scales as sqrt(T/Tref), with Tref=300K for the selected H getter and273.15K for the Day helium data, only if net capture probability is maintained by precooling/shielding. Actual warm incidence and mixture poisoning require review.
The optical row assumes hot projected view equals active area. A physical manifold must supply its actual ratio; increasing sorberarea doesnot automatically create a hot aperture.
He cold duty assumes a200K intercept really blocks direct1000K photons; the first-intercept heat is separately listed and cannot disappear.
Front open fraction uses competition with the entire downstreamseries conductance. Pumpbasepressure and materialpermeation require additive backstreaming terms.

thermal_integration_rule: Receiver1000K photons routed to a colder stage are an internal hot-to-cold bypass: debit engine heat and credit cold rejection once. Subsequent200K-to5K transfer is part of that staged exchange, not another source energy. Refrigerator work is an additional electrical debit and ultimate heat rejection.
